pages.title: Sthenurus
pages.text: $(o)Sthenurus$() ($(o)Sthenurus stirlingi$()) was a large short-faced kangaroo that lived in southern Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Like its relative Procoptodon, it browsed on shrubs and trees using its long arms.$(br2)Studies of its skeleton suggest it may have walked upright on its hind legs, one foot at a time, rather than hopping.
